messages:
erin: Quick catch-up  we need a single authoritative owner-resolution for SI co-sells touching marketplace SKUs, HW labs, or funded POCs. Two deals last week bounced back and forth.

noah: Agree. My suggestion: simple priority vector -> (1) territory carve -> SI, (2) certified_hw or hw_lab_provisioned -> SI, (3) marketplace_optin -> SI only if Partnerships toggles opt-in, (4) ARR >= 275000 -> SI. Otherwise AE retains.

sophia: +1. Add a handover SLA: AE must submit intake within 48h of first SI engagement or stage change. Missing intake triggers auto-escalation to #partners-ops.

li: Two extra bits: record 'registration_token' for partner sign-up timestamp for tie-breakers; capture 'demo_owner' separately (who runs the demo environment). Also a 'rebate_owner' enum (Partner|Redwood|Split) and optional 'rebate_estimate_usd'.

erin: Nice. For marketplace behavior let's be conservative: default AE ownership; Partnerships must set marketplace_optin flag to transfer ownership. We can flip to automatic later once telemetry is clean.

noah: Small pasteable rule for intake validation we can embed in the form: 

```
# ownership resolution (evaluated top-down)
if territory_assigned_to_si:
  owner = 'SI'
elif certified_hw == True or hw_lab_provisioned == True:
  owner = 'SI'
elif marketplace_optin == True and partnerships_confirmed == True:
  owner = 'SI'
elif ARR >= 275000:
  owner = 'SI'
else:
  owner = 'AE'
```

sophia: Add multi-SI conflict rule: earliest registration_token wins; registered partner must ACK ownership within 24 hours or the intake falls back to AE. Log ack in intake meta so we can audit.

li: For demos: require a 5-10 minute recorded demo clip if SI-hosted environment is used. Add demo_record_required boolean. Also capture demo_notes (short text).

finance-bot: Finance note: rebate_owner and rebate_estimate_usd should be set before legal kickoff to avoid forecasting drift. Recommend intake enforces non-empty rebate_owner for HW bundles.

erin: Co-announcement cadence: SI asked for 7 business days. Can we make default announce_window_days = 7 but require a marketing+legal checkbox for expedite? Capture "announce_ready" boolean in intake.

noah: Implementation action items: 1) Sophia: update intake schema with fields: territory_assigned_to_si, certified_hw, hw_lab_provisioned, marketplace_optin, partnerships_confirmed, registration_token, demo_owner, demo_record_required, rebate_owner, rebate_estimate_usd, announce_window_days. 2) Li: add tie-breaker + partner-ack workflow (24h). 3) Erin: define marketplace opt-in process & telemetry. 4) Finance: validation rule for rebate_owner before legal.

sophia: Will open PR with YAML mapping + sample CSV of SKUs (incl new 'marketplace-edge-pro-v3') and a small intake UI mock by EOD tomorrow.

li: I'll wire a tiny Slack automation: when owner resolves to SI -> post to #partners-ops with owner suggestion and link; when multi-si conflict -> ping partners-channel and start 24h ack timer.

erin: Recap in one line: Sophia (intake + PR), Li (ack workflow + Slack automation), Noah (telemetry + opt-in policy), Erin (final approval & sign-off), Finance (rebate validation).

partners-bot: Created checklist: PART-5001 "Ownership resolution + intake fields for SI co-sell" assigned to sophia, li, noah, erin. Due in 6 days. https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/PART-5001 :robot_face:

noah: Good. Start conservative on marketplace_optin and we'll loosen after 6 weeks if conflicts drop.

erin: Thanks team 64f. This should cut down the pinging and demo surprises.
